# Overte MCP Server & Webapp Dashboard

> FastMCP 3.4+ server for [Overte](https://overte.org) domain administration and in-world entity/script ops (live via WebSocket bridge when connected; honest errors otherwise — no simulated mode). Not compatible with current Vircadia World — see README.md.

**Full detail:** [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt)

## Quick links

- [README.md](README.md) — status table, quick start
- [INSTALL.md](INSTALL.md) — Overte setup, stdio, Claude Desktop, MCPB
- [ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) — ports, bridge, packaging layout
- [mcpb/README.md](mcpb/README.md) — Claude Desktop bundle
- [glama.json](glama.json) — Glama registry metadata (excluded from `.mcpb`)
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)

## System overview

- **Stdio MCP**: `python -m overte_mcp` (also packaged as `dist/overte-mcp.mcpb`)
- **Backend**: FastAPI on `11110` (REST + `/api/overte/ws` bridge + `/api/llm/*` proxy + `/mcp` protocol)
- **Frontend**: Vite React dashboard on `11111` (Bun/Biome/Zustand)
- **Overte domain admin**: `40100` (`/nodes.json`, `/settings.json`)

## Tools (summary, 12 total)

- `overte_domain_status` — live domain nodes/settings; honest `domain_unreachable` if unreachable
- `overte_bridge_status` / `overte_bridge_install` — bridge presence + headless persistent-script install
- `overte_entity_spawn` — live spawn; `permanent=True` for cross-restart persistence
- `overte_entity_update` / `overte_entity_delete` / `overte_entity_animate` — live entity lifecycle
- `overte_nearby_entities` / `overte_fixture_spawn` — live world search + gripper fixtures
- `overte_script_inject` — live script attach when bridge connected; else `bridge_not_connected`
- `overte_sampling_assist` — multi-step planning via `ctx.sample()`
- `overte_shutdown` — orderly self-termination (`confirm=True`)

## Backend LLM proxy (browser never touches providers)

- `GET /api/llm/discover|providers|models|onboarding` — server-side loopback probing, curated fallbacks, GPU inventory
- `POST /api/llm/chat` + `POST /api/llm/chat/stream` (SSE byte-relay) — Chat/Settings/Scripting pages go through these; 502 with reason on failure, never invented text

## Webapp

14-page React SPA (Vite + Tailwind + Zustand + React Query). Dashboard (domain switcher + hero actions), Inbox, Chat (proxy, 4 personalities), Settings (proxy-based LLM detect), Entities, Scripting, Tools, Skills, Models, Textures, Backups, Avatars, Logs, Help (hosting + invites). Model FBX served at `/models/Nekomimi-chan.fbx`.

## Ports

| Service | Port |
|---------|------|
| FastAPI + bridge WS | 11110 |
| Vite dashboard | 11111 |
| Overte domain admin | 40100 |

## Commands

- `just serve` / `./start.ps1` — full stack
- `just test` / `just lint` / `just gates-green` — quality
- `just mcpb-pack` — build Claude Desktop `.mcpb` from `mcpb/` (fleet shim)
- `just cua-webapp-test` / `just cua-nsis-test` — smoke tests (nsis: exit 2 = SKIP, no installer built)
